_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

columns.name: site_id
columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES site (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES site (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

data.name: ux_config_source_url
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_config_source_url ON config_source(url) WHERE url IS NOT NULL

data.name: ux_site_scope_key
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_site_scope_key ON site(COALESCE(config_id,-1), COALESCE(plugin_id,''), site_key)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "config_source" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "raw_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NOT NULL, "auto_update" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_update" IN (0, 1)), "update_interval_h" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 24, "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plugin" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "prev_version" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "runtime" TEXT NULL, "install_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_market" TEXT NULL, "manifest_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "granted_permissions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "integrity_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "signature_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unsigned', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "installed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "site" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "config_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES config_source (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "plugin_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES plugin (plugin_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "site_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_code" INTEGER NOT NULL, "runtime" TEXT NOT NULL, "api" TEXT NOT NULL, "ext" TEXT NULL, "searchable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("searchable" IN (0, 1)), "quick_search" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("quick_search" IN (0, 1)), "filterable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("filterable" IN (0, 1)), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "fail_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_ok_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "last_latency_ms" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK ((config_id IS NULL) <> (plugin_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "site_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES site (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "vod_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vod_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "vod_pic" TEXT NULL, "flag" TEXT NULL, "episode_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "episode_name" TEXT NULL, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "finished" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("finished" IN (0, 1)), "opening_ms" INTEGER NULL, "ending_ms" INTEGER NULL, "play_rate" REAL NULL, "audio_track" TEXT NULL, "subtitle_track" TEXT NULL, "played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "site_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES site (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "vod_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vod_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "vod_pic" TEXT NULL, "vod_remarks" TEXT NULL, "latest_remarks" TEXT NULL, "folder" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notify_update" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notify_update" IN (0, 1)), "last_check_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "site_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES site (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "vod_id" TEXT NULL, "vod_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "episode_name" TEXT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "headers_json" TEXT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "done_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_segments" INTEGER NULL, "done_segments" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "speed_bps" INTEGER NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_segment" ("download_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES download (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("download_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plugin_setting" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plugin (plugin_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id", "key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plugin_storage" ("owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "live_group" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "config_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES config_source (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "live_channel" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES live_group (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "logo" TEXT NULL, "urls_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "epg_id" TEXT NULL, "headers_json" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "last_played_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parse_rule" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "config_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES config_source (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type_code" INTEGER NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "ext_json" TEXT NULL, "flags_json" TEXT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "success_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fail_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "avg_latency_ms" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "site_cache" ("cache_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES site (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" BLOB NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cache_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setting" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history" ("keyword" TEXT NOT NULL, "hit_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', PRIMARY KEY ("keyword"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_event" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "site_id" INTEGER NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "detail_json" TEXT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_config_source_url ON config_source (url) WHERE url IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_site_scope_key ON site (COALESCE(config_id, -1), COALESCE(plugin_id, ''), site_key)
CREATE INDEX ix_site_enabled ON site (enabled, priority)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_history_item ON history (site_id, vod_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_history_recent ON history (played_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_favorite_item ON favorite (site_id, vod_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_favorite_folder ON favorite (folder, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX ix_download_status ON download (status, priority, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_plugin_storage_owner ON plugin_storage (owner)
CREATE INDEX ix_live_channel_group ON live_channel (group_id, sort_order)
CREATE INDEX ix_live_channel_name ON live_channel (name)
CREATE INDEX ix_site_cache_expiry ON site_cache (expires_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_event_ts ON app_event (ts)
CREATE INDEX ix_app_event_scope ON app_event (scope, ts)
